name: Admiral Beckett Brass
oracle_text:
Other Pirates you control get +1/+1.
At the beginning of your end step, gain control of target nonland permanent controlled by a player who was dealt combat damage by three or more Pirates this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, gain control of target nonland permanent controlled by a player who was dealt combat damage by three or more Pirates this turn.

needs.what: a per-player count of DISTINCT creatures with a given subtype (here Pirate, read as the damage lands) that dealt combat damage to that player this turn, usable as a threshold in a player spec / selector `controller` -- e.g. `{"dealt_combat_damage_by": {"subtypes": ["Pirate"], "at_least": 3}}` -- so a permanent target can be restricted to nonland permanents controlled by a player hit by three or more Pirates
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `dealt_combat_damage_by` with `{"subtypes": ["Pirate"]}` reads `turn_ledger.players_dealt_combat_damage_by_subtype`, which is a set of seats hit by ANY Pirate, with no record of how many distinct Pirates hit each seat; `players_dealt_combat_damage_by` is keyed per source oid but does not remember each source's subtype at damage time; the `combat_damage_by` condition is table-wide and says only that a Pirate got through. Using the subtype set would let one Pirate unlock the steal, a much stronger card
